assign.outcome:
**Columns are a core page shape.** `page.columns()` on a host and its whole subtree lays out as full-height columns, each child opening to the right. Graduated from the demo into [`Page.css`](/framework/core/Page/doc/file/Page.css/) + `Page.class.js`; the demo is now an ordinary tree that calls the method.

- [Finder](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/finder/) — the shape at page height, real urls, three levels deep
- [Columns demo + source](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/) — the same tree in a box
- [`doc/columns.md`](/framework/core/Page/doc/columns/) — the words, the mechanism, seven traps, two open questions

![1920](columns-1920.png)

**Vocabulary** — `columns()` `column_host()` `crumbs(from)` `render_column()` `column()` `reveal_column()` `scroll_column()`; classes `.page.columns` `.page.column` `.page-columns-bar` `.page-columns-row` `.page-column-body/-pages/-head/-title/-close/-prose/-item/-label` `.page-crumbs`; width words `width: "small" | "large" | "full"` -> tokens `--page-column-flex/-min/-max`.

**Measured 3440** (row 3166): small 252 - default 720 - large 1152 - full 3166. Cold load at a five-deep url and clicking down to it both give **5** visible columns; the demo tree gives **3** fresh and **3** back on the same page after a deep round trip. Zero console errors at 400/1280/1920/3440. The only scroller is the row, on x, only when the columns overflow.

**Two bugs the measuring found** — `:has()` kept matching a *closed* `full` column, so its ancestors never came back (the mark is now part of the test); and navigating UP activates nothing, so the crumb strip kept the departed leaf (`deactivate()` refreshes it too).

**Left / for the owner** — `old/overview/columns/` was **deleted**, not renamed: two sheets cannot own one class name. Dead space right of the last column at 3440 is a taste call (doc/columns.md, Open). `core/Page/page.js` still lists the deleted `overview/columns/columns.css` in `files:` and could gain `overview/columns/finder/page.js` plus `columns crumbs` in `methods:` — that file belongs to the generator agent.
